notes: Claude (through Claude Code) can now rename, move, recolour and delete items, delete empty folders, add a template with all its sub-items, set sub-items and reload the job, all while the job is open: page tabs stay open, colours stay as set, and Ctrl+Z undoes each change. It can also read a PDF drawing's text and pipe lines, and check what it found on a picture before adding it. Colours typed by hand in a job file are no longer lost.
